name: mp-resume-from-disk-relay
title: Autosave on, both players' processes killed on their own machines, the match resumed from disk there and played on over the relay; the frame rate judged at a real autosave interval

DataModule
	ModuleName = User Scenes
	ScanFolderContents = 1
	IgnoreMissingItems = 1
	AddActivity = GAScripted
		CopyOf = P4 Alpha Duel
		PresetName = Determinism FeelBaseline

		LuaClassName = FeelBaseline
		TeamOfPlayer1 = 0
		Player1IsHuman = 1
		TeamOfPlayer2 = 1

checklist.what: Recovery visibly keeps Autosave on; a typed one-second interval clamps to the shortest valid interval, sixty seconds. The one-second stress cadence is the run's test lever (-net-autosave-seconds 1).
events: assert_label ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval "1 second" text="1 second" PASS

checklist.what: The peer plays the original match before either process is killed.
The original match keeps playing after two distinct autosaves at the test lever's one-second cadence have been published.
The video ends at the recorded process kill after tick 600, with the disk state retained.
The relaunched peer displays the restored match and checkpoint tick.
log_regex: \[autosave\] resuming match=\S+ tick=\d+ activity=.* peers=\d+ directory=\S+

checklist.what: The restored world continues beyond its saved tick with at least 120 further simulation updates.
checklist.assert: the resumed round's committed frames across the marked window, which closes on the round's own frame 850 (and no sooner than 5 s), so a loaded box stretches the window instead of thinning it

scripts.stress.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
settext TextMultiplayerName Host
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 600
combo_select ComboHostActivity Determinism FeelBaseline
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 600
activate TabHostPageRecovery
video_mark resume-autosave-options
wait_ms 900
assert_visible CollectionBoxHostPageRecovery 1
setcheck CheckHostRecAutosave 1
wait_ms 600
observe assert_checked CheckHostRecAutosave 1
observe assert_enabled ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 1
wait_ms 600
observe assert_label ComboHostRecAutosaveInterval 1 second
observe assert_enabled ButtonHostOptApply 0
wait_ms 900
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
dump_host_options
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
assert_substate Lobby
video_mark resume-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_remote_ready 90
video_mark resume-ready-start
dump_lobby
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerStart 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/ready-to-drop.json 120
wait_ms 120000
scripts.died.client.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 120
wait_substate Lobby 60
wait_ms 900
assert_substate Lobby
video_mark resume-client-lobby
dump_lobby
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/ready-to-drop.json 120
wait_ms 240000
scripts.resumed.client.menu:
wait_ms 1800
assert_substate Landing
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerReconnect Rejoin Match
activate ButtonMultiplayerReconnect
wait_connected 2 120
wait_substate Lobby 60
wait_ms 900
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_round_end 300
wait_ms 1500
exit
